hero.title: Paint, protection and shine.
hero.lead: Repaint, body repair, tint, undercoating, ceramic coating and full detailing, done under one roof by the Zcars crew.
hero.image_alt: Black Mitsubishi Montero Sport with a fresh, glossy detail outside the Zcars garage

services.title: Everything your car needs
services.lead: From a dented bumper to a mirror finish. Bring it in once and drive out done.

steps.title: Message or call
steps.text: Tell us about your car, or send a photo through the quote form.

steps.title: Inspect and quote
steps.text: We check the car and give you a price before we start.

steps.title: Drive out done
steps.text: Pick up your car when the work is finished.

repaint.title: Prepped right, painted once.
repaint.lead: Every repaint starts with proper sanding and primer, the step most shops rush. That is why the finish lasts.
repaint.image_alt: White Subaru mid-repaint with primer on the front fender

quote.title: Get a quote
quote.lead: Tell us about your car and what it needs. We will call or message you back.

visit.title: Drop by Sagkahan
visit.lead: Call ahead so we can have a bay ready for you.

team.title: A garage that trains the next crew
team.lead: Zcars hosts automotive OJT students from EVSU, learning the trade on real cars in our shop.
team.image_alt: EVSU automotive OJT students with a Zcars detailer inside the garage
team.caption: EVSU Automotive OJT at the Zcars garage.
